attributes.name: Dwarven Clawhammer
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 1d4. If not proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4. If you would fail the check, you may discard this card to reroll the dice; take the new result.

Recharge this card to add 1d4 to your Craft or Disable check.
